text: haha wait did u just say that when i drag the color it basically is reconstituting the americas behind the scenes with it ?
resolution: Clarified the confirmed color-map drag cascade in plain terms: each raw captured pointer-motion event updates top-level AppFrame state, re-renders the editor and serializes the redacted whole EditorState to hot-state; the color-to-brush reconciliation then updates ModelView, whose full tool snapshot writes back into AppFrame and causes another render/persistence pass. Native captured motion is not coalesced for this control. No files changed.
